title: Social battery
label: PHONE BATTERY VS SOCIAL BATTERY
lead: Hook 1, because the object comparison lands in the first sentence and the pack draws a phone best.

hooks.label: PHONE BATTERY VS SOCIAL BATTERY
hooks.say: Your phone warns you before it dies. Your *social* battery never does.

hooks.label: PHONE BATTERY | SOCIAL BATTERY
hooks.say: Phone battery, social battery. Only one of them comes with a *warning*.

hooks.label: WHEN YOU'RE DONE AT DINNER
hooks.say: You're laughing at dinner, and inside you're already planning how to *leave*.

beats.say: Your phone warns you before it dies. Your *social* battery never does.
beats.scene: A phone flat on a dark table, buzzing, its screen showing a low red battery and a warning banner sliding down.

beats.say: The phone gets a red icon, a pop-up and a *charger*.
beats.scene: Close and low over the table: a cable races in and plugs into the phone, the bar turns green.

beats.say: You just get quieter at dinner, and nobody sees the *red* bar.
beats.scene: A dinner table at night, two plates, glasses and a candle. On the wall a large battery sign drains from green to red.

beats.say: Then you say *yes* to one more plan, because saying no feels rude.
beats.scene: An upright phone filling with invitation bubbles, one after another, a big YES stamped on the screen.

beats.say: So give yourself low power mode. A closed door, a *dim* lamp, an early night.
beats.scene: A door swings shut, light glows under it, a pendant bulb dims to a warm low glow.

beats.say: Send this to the friend who leaves the party early. They're just *charging*.
beats.scene: A bedside table at night: a phone plugged in, a heart battery on its screen filling green, the bulb above warming up.
